strings.name: Steven Spielberg
strings.summary: Steven Spielberg helped shape the modern blockbuster through Jaws, E.T. and Jurassic Park, while Schindler’s List and Saving Private Ryan addressed history and war. He co-founded Amblin and DreamWorks and established a Holocaust testimony project. His directing and producing depend on sustained collaboration with writers, actors, composers and technical teams.
strings.coverageNote: Sources checked through 13 November 2026; selected chronology extends to 2026-06-12. This is not a complete catalogue of works or appearances; later plans are not treated as completed events.
strings.influence.rationale: By directing Jaws, Schindler’s List and other films, he changed commercial filmmaking and the public communication of history.
strings.facts.fact-1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.fact-2.label: Education
strings.facts.fact-2.value: Completed a bachelor’s degree at California State University, Long Beach, in 2002
strings.highlights.highlight-1.title: Commercial cinema and popular storytelling
strings.highlights.highlight-1.text: Suspense, adventure and science-fiction films influenced blockbuster production and global distribution culture.
strings.highlights.highlight-2.title: Historical film and testimony
strings.highlights.highlight-2.text: Historical movies and the Shoah Foundation, established in 1994, supported public understanding of the Holocaust.
strings.timeline.event-1.title: Disclosure Day released
strings.timeline.event-1.text: His new science-fiction film opened, based on his story with a screenplay by David Koepp.
strings.timeline.event-2.title: Received a Grammy
strings.timeline.event-2.text: Won best music film as a producer of Music by John Williams, completing EGOT status.
strings.timeline.event-3.title: Released The Fabelmans
strings.timeline.event-3.text: A partly autobiographical coming-of-age story revisited family life and his fascination with film.
strings.timeline.event-4.title: Completed his university degree
strings.timeline.event-4.text: Returned to study and earned a bachelor’s degree at California State University, Long Beach.
strings.timeline.event-5.title: Second directing Oscar
strings.timeline.event-5.text: Received best director for Saving Private Ryan, released in 1998.
strings.timeline.event-6.title: Founded testimony project and DreamWorks
strings.timeline.event-6.text: Created the Shoah Foundation and co-founded DreamWorks with Jeffrey Katzenberg and David Geffen.
strings.timeline.event-7.title: Two landmark films released
strings.timeline.event-7.text: Jurassic Park and Schindler’s List advanced digital spectacle and historical storytelling in different ways.
strings.timeline.event-8.title: E.T. released
strings.timeline.event-8.text: A child’s perspective and science-fiction imagination connected audiences across ages.
strings.timeline.event-9.title: Co-founded Amblin
strings.timeline.event-9.text: Established the production company with Kathleen Kennedy and Frank Marshall.
strings.timeline.event-10.title: Jaws released
strings.timeline.event-10.text: The film advanced the production, promotion and distribution model of the summer blockbuster.
strings.timeline.event-11.title: Duel premiered on television
strings.timeline.event-11.text: The early suspense film drew attention to his directing.
strings.timeline.event-12.title: Born in Cincinnati
strings.timeline.event-12.text: Used small movie cameras as a youngster, gaining experience for his later career.
